2607.06929.title: MADB: A Large-Scale Music Aesthetics Dataset with Professional and Multi-Dimensional Annotations
2607.06929.paper_summary: Music aesthetic assessment is a challenging yet underexplored problem, requiring models to capture fine-grained, multi-dimensional human perceptual judgments. Progress in this area has been limited by the lack of large-scale datasets with structured aesthetic annotations. We introduce MADB, a large-scale dataset and benchmark comprising 9,999 tracks annotated by 30 trained annotators. Each track is rated by around 10 annotators across 10 perceptual dimensions and one overall score, with additional textual comments for multimodal analysis. We establish a unified evaluation framework over multiple pretrained models. Results reveal substantial gaps between model predictions and human judgments, exposing key limitations of current approaches. MADB provides a new benchmark for human-aligned music understanding. Project page: https://github.com/knownree/madb
2607.06929.paper_summary_zh: 音樂美學評估是一個具有挑戰性但尚未深入探索的問題，需要模型捕捉細緻、多維的人類感知判斷。這個領域的進展受到缺乏具有結構化美學註釋的大規模數據集的限制。我們介紹了MADB，一個包含9,999首曲目的大規模數據集和基準，這些曲目由30位訓練過的註釋者進行註釋。每首曲目由約10位註釋者在10個感知維度和一個整體評分上進行評價，並附有額外的文本評論以供多模態分析。我們在多個預訓練模型上建立了一個統一的評估框架。結果顯示模型預測與人類判斷之間存在顯著差距，揭示了當前方法的主要局限性。MADB為人類對齊的音樂理解提供了一個新的基準。項目頁面：https://github.com/knownree/madb
